privacy: Dataset aliases and aggregate measurements only. Production paths, images, camera arrays and source/exported identities are omitted. Original local reports remain ignored; their SHA256 hashes support local audit.
supersedes: The pre-fix visible_count/frustum_visible_rows values in the historical viewport-summary.json and its raw reports are incorrect on the tested NVIDIA driver. Those original files are preserved; their measured performance, source integrity and pixel/pick evidence remain historical observations. This file provides corrected measurements, not a silent replacement of prior raw data.

measurement_definition.window: Real GNOME/Mutter output; native GTK4 window and Gtk.GLArea; actual NVIDIA OpenGL context. No Xvfb or EGL pbuffer.
measurement_definition.protocol: The four corrected runs share the same new benchmark tool SHA. Historical runs use an earlier tool SHA; the tool correction collects all metric fields from one fresh polled snapshot. Each corresponding historical/corrected 94-case plan was verified exactly equal: 12 measured samples plus 2 warmups for resident, orbit, pan, dolly and resident playback; 4 native intervals, streaming playback and 5 exact picks. Both tool hashes are retained in every comparison.
measurement_definition.source_camera: Same compatible source camera/view and native time for before/after; exact numerical equality verified, arrays omitted.
measurement_definition.cpu_prepare: Read-only SceneDocument.prepare_frame on one background worker; calibration preparation recorded separately.
measurement_definition.cpu_submission: Normal product viewport render callback CPU wall time, including upload/sort submission.
measurement_definition.gpu_elapsed: Asynchronous GL_TIME_ELAPSED for sort/render. Under shared GPU scheduling this is elapsed device timeline, not isolated shader-cycle cost.
measurement_definition.gl_completion_wall: One request in flight; nonblocking GL fence after normal GLArea render. Includes event-loop/poll scheduling; excludes later GTK/compositor/desktop presentation.
measurement_definition.combined_latency: CPU preparation plus calibration preparation plus queued GL completion wall, kept separate from GPU-only elapsed.
measurement_definition.exact_pick: pick_blocking_wall_ms includes the production GPU projection/readback and CPU identity reduction. In exact_pick phase, gpu_ms describes the subsequent selection-feedback render, not an isolated pick GPU timer.
measurement_definition.memory: Linux process RSS/high-water mark includes NumPy/mmap/driver allocations. Declared GPU resident bytes are renderer estimates, not total device VRAM.
measurement_definition.cold: First process operation only; OS page cache is uncontrolled. Source validation is not cold-storage throughput.

shared_gpu_load.method: Read-only nvidia-smi snapshots immediately before/after each serialized corrected viewport benchmark; shared jobs remain running
shared_gpu_load.limitation: Existing unrelated workloads remained running. Before/after snapshots do not measure continuous load. Previous pre-fix AFTER captures were 100% busy on both GPUs; corrected-run snapshots ranged 20–99% and 61–100%. GPU elapsed changes across these runs cannot be attributed solely to this counter correction or the renderer. No desktop presentation FPS, isolated throughput or 60-fps claim is made.

integrity_scope: Source regular-file dev/ino/size/mtime/ctime unchanged before/after and across matching historical/corrected runs. The normal SceneDocument loader validated SDK sample/buffer checksums and reported manifest SHA256. Whole-file before/after SHA256 was explicitly skipped to avoid re-reading multi-GB production sources; no whole-file cryptographic identity claim is made.
